style: Original flat graphic emblem for a fictional authoritarian bureaucratic world government in a retro pixel-art game, a decal source. Severe, orderly, institutional and unmistakably authoritarian: heavy symmetrical geometry like an official state seal or rubber stamp. Bold simple shapes with thick clean edges, flat solid colours only: near-black #1E1E22, deep Union red #8C1A1E and bone #E8E2D6. No gradients, no shading, no texture, readable when reduced to 64 pixels
view: Straight-on flat front view, one emblem centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame, perfectly mirror-symmetrical left to right
technical: Entire background perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no border, no frame around the image. No text, letters, numbers, inscriptions, logos or watermark

frames.subject: The Union register seal: a circular seal, a solid near-black disc with a thick deep-red outer ring studded with evenly spaced small square bone rivets, a thin bone inner ring, and at the centre a bone podium mark made of three stacked horizontal bars that widen downward like ordered tiers, a short bone vertical bar standing on top

The Union access plate: an upright octagonal near-black plate with a thick deep-red border band and a thin bone inner border, at the centre a bold bone square frame enclosing a deep-red keyhole-shaped slot, two small bone horizontal bars below the square like a signature line

The Union permission gate: a solid deep-red disc with a thick near-black inner ring and a thin bone outer edge, at the centre a bold bone gate symbol: two upright posts joined by a flat lintel, and one horizontal barrier bar closing the opening between them

The Union continuance stamp: a tall rectangular official stamp with a near-black field and a double deep-red border, at the centre an unbroken thick bone ring enclosing a solid deep-red square set on its corner, a row of small identical bone rectangles along the top and bottom edges like a registry index
